_comment: drag-lint's lint config for its OWN source.
IT NO LONGER NEEDS --config. This used to say: pass with --config when
linting this repo from a neutral CWD, because auto-discovery only looked
in the CWD and the pipeline runs from C:\TEMP. That stopped being true on
2026-08-28: lint-all now anchors config discovery to the --db path and
walks up, so src\cli\_D-RAG\drag-lint.sqlite reaches this file at the repo
root from any working directory. An explicit --config still wins.
exclude_paths: third_party\delphi-tree-sitter is VENDORED UPSTREAM code. It
is in the index because it is part of the .dproj compile closure and symbol
resolution needs it -- but it is not ours to restyle. It accounted for 134 of
2,765 findings, 95 of them method-pascalcase on C binding names such as
ts_query_cursor_new, where renaming would diverge from upstream and turn
every future sync into a conflict. tests\autotest\run_encoding_guard.ps1
already exempts this exact directory for this exact reason.
